function.description: Get the current top ranked athlete for a specific sport. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

sport.description: The sport to get the ranking for.

message.content:
LeBron James is an American professional basketball player widely regarded as one of the greatest athletes of all time. Born on December 30, 1984, in Akron, Ohio, he rose to prominence as a high‑school phenom at St. Vincent‑St. Mary High School, where he was named the 2003 Mr. Basketball USA and the 2004 Naismith High School Player of the Year.

He entered the NBA directly from high school, being selected first overall by the Cleveland Cavaliers in the 2003 draft. LeBron quickly became a dominant force in the league, earning the NBA Rookie of the Year award in 2004 and being named an All‑Star in each of his first 13 seasons. He has won four NBA championships (2012, 2013, 2016, 2020) and has earned four NBA Most Valuable Player (MVP) awards (2009, 2010, 2012, 2013). His career averages exceed 27 points, 7 rebounds, and 7 assists per game, and he has been named to the All‑NCAA First Team, the All‑NBA First Team, and the NBA All‑Defensive First Team multiple times.

Beyond the court, LeBron is known for his philanthropy, most notably the LeBron James Family Foundation, which opened the “I Promise School” in Akron to support at-risk children. He has also pursued a successful media career, producing and starring in films and television shows, and he is a prominent voice on social and political issues.
